✈️ Flight Correlator fetches real-time aviation data from OpenSky Network and correlates it against country-level economic and demographic indicators.
📊 Rankings — See which countries have the most active flights at any given moment.
🔗 Correlations — Compare flight volume against population and GDP to uncover which nations punch above their weight in aviation.
📈 Trends — Track how global flight volumes change throughout the week and across regions.
Data: OpenSky Network API • Population: World Bank • GDP: IMF 2024
